title: Payload Debrief: Compact Failure Matrix & Retry Triage Flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, scannable Failure Matrix card and an associated Retry Triage interaction that surfaces: error taxonomy, retry history, payload diff snapshots, and a lightweight hypothesis composer. This work is aimed at reducing mean time to diagnosis for engineering and SRE teams using the Redwood Console while keeping the primary console listing dense and performance-friendly.
background: Current error investigation flows in Console require opening a heavy Request Detail panel for every investigate action. For high-volume teams this adds cognitive overload and slows triage. We need a condensed surface that lets on-call engineers scan, annotate, and kick off retries or rollbacks without losing the rich payload-inspection capabilities.
goals: Provide a single-line failure summary that expands in-place to a compact matrix of error characteristics
Make retry attempts and outcomes visible at-a-glance and enable one-click speculative replays
Expose key payload diffs (request vs. last-successful) inline with quick copy / export
Surface error taxonomy filters so teams can group similar failures across time windows
Keep render cost low and preserve Console performance at 2000 concurrent rows
constraints: Must reuse Console list virtualization layers (no new full DOM expansions)
Payload previews limited to 3KB trimmed view; full payload links open full detail panel
Access control: private deployment must honor RBAC and KMS masking rules
Design must play nicely with existing rollout canary badges and automatic fallback UI
acceptance_criteria: Compact Failure Matrix shown on hover/expand for list rows without navigating away
Matrix columns: error class, last retry status, retry count, latency deviation, cost delta, payload diff badge
One-click 'Speculative Replay' button invokes existing retry API with prefilled hypothesis and shows an immediate micro-result toast
Taxonomy filter available as a multi-select chip in the matrix with counts and sample payload links
Performance: expansion render time < 120ms on cold list virtualization sample (internal perf test)
decisions: Use an inline expansion rather than modal to preserve list context and fast comparisons
Limit inline payload preview to a collapsed diff with explicit 'show full' action to avoid heavy parsing
Embed retry action that calls existing /retry endpoint and surface micro-result via toasts; full replay trace available in Detail panel
Implement taxonomy as tag buckets derived from existing error classifier service rather than introducing new classification logic
tradeoffs: Inline expansion reduces navigation friction but increases per-row render logic; mitigated with virtualization reuse
Limiting payload preview size keeps perf acceptable but may hide edge-case debug details—link to full panel required
One-click speculative replays accelerate triage but could increase backend load; need rate-limits and quota checks in API layer
progress_updates: 2025-02-02: Low-fidelity wireframes completed; shared with PM and Eng for feasibility review
2025-02-05: Eng flagged payload diffing CPU cost; agreed to cap preview size and offload diff to worker queue
2025-02-09: Prototype with interactive retry button built in Figma; initial usability test with 3 SREs shows mean time to first-action improvement of 42%
2025-02-11: Accessibility pass - keyboard expand/collapse added; color contrast for taxonomy chips adjusted
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Lee): Prefer showing cost delta with tooltip that explains unit calculation to reduce confusion
Eng Lead (Priya Nair): Require server-side limiting for speculative replay to prevent noisy replays during incidents
Security (Devon Chen): Ensure payload previews honor PII redaction rules from KMS; provide default masked view for private deployments
Design Peer (Rae Thompson): Request an 'acknowledge' state to mark that an engineer has triaged the row without mutating backend data
next_steps: Finalize high-fidelity specs and handoff tokenized components to eng (button states, chip styles, diff badge)
Add server-side limits for preview size and speculative replay rate with Eng (ENG-24119)
Run broader usability testing with 8 participants across SRE and PM teams during Cycle 2025-W06
Prepare rollout plan: feature flag behind "compact-failure-matrix" and staged rollout to non-enterprise orgs first
notes: Prototype intentionally avoids embedding full KV cache viewer; that will remain in Request Detail to keep the inline surface focused and fast. Consider a keyboard-first triage shortcut in future iteration.
